title: All-Distinct Lullaby
prompt:
**Scenario.** A candidate solution passed 500 random tests, all with distinct values. Which category should you test FIRST?

**Which approach is the best fit? The program only needs to print the letter.**

**A)** Signed overflow — always first

**B)** Tie-breaking — all-distinct data cannot exercise equal-key branches, so those paths are completely untested

**C)** Direction confusion

**D)** Ordered/unordered counting

tests.name: answer
tests.hint: Random distinct data never generates ties: the >=/ > and secondary-key branches ran zero times. That is the biggest untested surface.
